people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: God gave Solomon abundant wisdom and understanding, and very great understanding, even as the sand that is on the seashore.
translations.bsb: And God gave Solomon wisdom, exceedingly deep insight, and understanding beyond measure, like the sand on the seashore.
translations.kjv: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
translations.asv: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea-shore.
